summary: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger under which its subsidiary, Kruger Merger Sub LLC, will merge into Noble Africa LLC, a subsidiary of ASP Isotopes Inc. The transaction involves a concurrent investment in Noble by ASPI and institutional investors for approximately $50 million at $6.57 per unit, and a contribution of Renergen to Noble for Class B Units. The voting structure grants ASPI 10 votes per share post-merger, indicating a change of control. The board's recommendation and advisors are not named. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory approvals.
